problem_restatement.known_input: BRENTOIL has exact live-canary liquidity, fill, fee, funding, stop, and slippage evidence.
problem_restatement.unknown_output: Whether a repeatable oil-shock edge survives prospectively after realistic live-tail friction.
problem_restatement.success_scope: Measure a frozen session challenger without changing v51 execution, risk, routing, or capital authority.

live_canary.interpretation: Execution feasibility is established; automatic strategy edge is not.

post_hoc_outside_us_slice.warning: This was selected after observing development outcomes and is not confirmatory evidence.

validation_plan.diagnostic_update_minimum: At least one fully attributable resolved lifecycle per side.
validation_plan.change_recommendation_minimum: A predeclared compatible window with at least 30 resolved lifecycles, at least 10 per side, exact fees/funding/slippage/latency/stops, and no unresolved entry or exit path.
required_analysis: comparison with unchanged v51 and no BRENTOIL route
validation_plan.oos_rule: Validation and holdout remain sealed until the frozen development-independent evidence contract is satisfied and explicitly reviewed.

failure_modes: The apparent session effect may be selection bias from one development window.
Sparse shock onsets may make 30 lifecycles slow to obtain.
The observed 8.46 bps slippage tail may understate future gaps or overstate typical cost.
Candle-source mismatch or unresolved mark/L2 paths can invalidate lifecycle economics.
Long and short performance may diverge even when pooled performance appears positive.

success_metrics.primary: positive live-tail-stress net after costs and after removing the largest winner
success_metrics.robustness: both sides individually nonnegative under stress and a majority of chronological slices positive
success_metrics.technical: all evaluated entry, barrier, exit, fee, funding, and quote paths resolved
success_metrics.portfolio: incremental benefit versus leaving the oil slot unused

failure_or_invalidation_triggers: provider/profile/config identity changes after the prospective boundary
unresolved entry or exit path used in an economic claim
stress net or stress ex-largest-winner net is nonpositive at the recommendation checkpoint
one direction supplies all positive economics while the frozen bidirectional claim remains unchanged
recommendation: Continue the existing isolated observer and prospectively classify the frozen outside-U.S.-regular-hours challenger. Do not add BRENTOIL to v51 or alter any strategy parameter.

confidence.reason: Canary execution is directly observed, but the session result is post-hoc and has no eligible prospective lifecycle yet.
